approvedPreview.unicorn:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single original character illustration for a premium children's tablet game called Allie's Playground, for age six.
Primary request: design one lovable original baby unicorn, full body, facing slightly right in a three-quarter side view, standing with one front hoof lifted in a gentle welcoming pose. Four anatomically coherent short legs, a round expressive head, a small rounded muzzle, exactly one short spiral golden horn, two small ears, kind dark plum eyes with tiny highlights, subtle peach cheeks. Cream-white coat, flowing short dusty-rose and muted-lilac mane and tail with just a hint of mint. Rounded soft-edged hooves and a tiny simple golden star on its cheek-side accessory. No wings.
Style: refined modern picture-book gouache illustration, warm hand-painted subtle paper texture inside shapes, clean confident cocoa-plum contour, soft volume, beautifully composed appealing silhouette, child-friendly proportions, understated details. Not shiny plastic, not 3D rendering, not anime, not clip art. It must feel like an original character an illustrator would develop for a finished premium family app.
Composition: single isolated character centered on a genuinely transparent canvas, square format, character occupies about 78% of both dimensions, at least 10% empty transparent margin on every side, every hoof, horn and tail fully visible. No other objects or fragments. No white sticker border, no text, no watermark, no background or floor. Character is not derived from any existing branded character.
Color palette: cream #FFF8EF, dusty rose #D998AF, lavender #B9A7CF, mint #AFCFC1, honey gold #D6B66E, warm deep plum outlines #655267.

images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single original little storybook princess, full body, standing in a welcoming pose with one hand holding her skirt and the other giving a little wave. Reference image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the cream, dusty rose, muted lavender, mint and honey gold gouache rendering, soft plum contours and charming proportions of the baby unicorn. The princess is an original fictional child character, not a portrait of a real child. Warm medium-brown wavy bob hair with short bangs, small gold crown with three round tips and a lavender heart gem, warm kind plum eyes, subtle peach cheeks, cream and lavender simple puff-sleeve dress with a rose ribbon sash, scalloped hem, gold tiny stars, rounded lavender shoes. Simple elegant child-friendly modest dress with broad readable shapes. No wand, no wings, no unicorn features. Refined hand-painted picture-book quality, subtle paper texture inside shapes, appealing cohesive silhouette, no recognizable existing branded character, no anime, no shiny plastic or 3D. Single character isolated on genuinely transparent square canvas, full body all limbs crown shoes visible, generous margins, centered 78% image. No floor, background, text, watermark or white sticker border.

Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Edit the provided unicorn image into a coloring-book line-art version of exactly the SAME original character. Preserve pose, proportions, head/eye shape, four legs with one lifted foreleg, horn, tail, star accessory, orientation and silhouette. Convert to clean smooth near-black outlines on pure white. This is an easy coloring page for a six-year-old: simplify textured fur and tiny hairs away, use large closed coloring regions for cream body, 3 to 5 broad mane and tail ribbons, hooves, horn segments and star. Eyes can remain near-black with white highlights; otherwise NO color, NO gray, NO hatching, NO shading, NO texture. Moderate uniform outer outline and slightly finer inner lines, solid uninterrupted boundaries, rounded flowing curves. No new objects, no page border, no text. Center whole unicorn with comfortable white margins, full horn tail hooves visible. White opaque background.

Use case: illustration-story. No characters, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no frames, no repetitive stamped decorations. Keep the central path and upper central sky quiet and uncluttered; objects belong at the sides.
